text:
sam (Sales): Hey legal/security — ACME wants to review a subset of our SOC 2 artifacts during the POC. They asked for the SOC 2 report + some evidence files. Can we provide a time-limited presigned S3 link + bridge letter? They said they need access by EOD tomorrow. Thoughts?

lisa (Legal): We can do a bridge letter + limited evidence, but need NDA signed and an explicit scope. We should not hand over unredacted personnel data or configs. Legal needs customer name + POC scope. I'll draft a bridge ack if you confirm the exact files.

irina (Security): +1 to NDA first. Technical controls: set presigned link expiry to 24h, restrict to specific objects, enable access logging, and IP allowlist if possible. Also require signed acknowledgement that they won't redistribute. We can also provide redacted extracts instead of raw logs.

ravi (Engineering): We can generate presigned URLs via our internal tooling. Default SDK expiry is 7d, but we can set to 24h or 1h. For two-stage access we can create one-time tokens. Example CLI to create 24h link:

```bash
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-soc2/poc-acme-pack.zip --expires-in 86400
```

If you want IP restrictions we'll need to host behind a signed proxy — adds ~2 hours ops work.

emma (AE): ACME pushed for EOD tomorrow. If legal needs NDA, can we fast-track? Also confirm if sharing parts of report implies any licensing/pricing implications for Dedicated/private deals.

lisa (Legal): We can do a simple mutual NDA (template) and the bridge letter. If AE can get countersigned NDA by noon, legal will approve the bridge text. Send customer's legal contact.

sam (Sales): Customer legal is jane.doe@acme.com and they'll sign. I'll push for noon. Ravi — can you prepare two packages: (1) redacted controls + sample evidence PDFs, (2) raw logs for security review (behind stricter access)?

ravi (Engineering): Yep — will prep package (1) as presigned zip with 24h expiry, package (2) will be behind an IP-restricted S3 endpoint; need customer IPs and signed NDA. ETA 3pm tomorrow.

irina (Security): Once NDA is in place, security team will run a quick checklist: confirm redactions, verify logging, SNS alert on access. Also need confirmation that the bridge letter will include statement that this is interim access for evaluation only.

sam (Sales): Great — I'll chase NDA and send customer IPs. Lisa, can you post bridge letter template here or DM? If legal approves, I'll send both NDA + bridge and a link to the presigned package when ready. :thumbsup: 

lisa (Legal): Uploading template here: https://redwood.internal/legal/templates/bridge-ack-template-v2.md. Use the 'interim access' variant. I'll standby for countersign.

security-bot: Reminder: create audit trail ticket #SR-4521 for evidence handoff (ops required).
